quote: The world always has more to show.
bio: Orion knows paths others can't even imagine. Patient, observant, and always one step ahead.

abilities.name: Mark Quarry
abilities.effect: Marks a target in sight: while he hunts it, +1d4 damage against it and advantage to track it.

abilities.name: Natural Explorer
abilities.effect: Can't get lost by nonmagical means, moves at normal pace through difficult terrain, and spots things at twice the distance while exploring.

abilities.name: Primeval Sense
abilities.effect: Advantage on Perception and Tracking outdoors and in natural passages.

goal: Map what no map has dared to name.
